text.p: Brooke Group Ltd said Thursday its Liggett Group tobacco subsidiary has added a "prominent" warning label to packs of L&M premium brand of cigarettes stating "smoking is addictive."
Liggett, which said it is the only U.S. cigarette maker to acknowledge the addictive nature of cigarette smoking, began distributing L&M cigarettes with the new label today.
Liggett said it added the label as part of its previously announced settlement agreements with the attorneys general of 23 states and individual and class action tobacco plaintiffs.

Brooke and Liggett also announced that Liggett's new warning label will be placed on its other premium brands -- Chesterfield, Lark and Eve -- and other cigarettes made and sold by Liggett within 60 days.

"We've moved quickly to honor our commitment to the attorneys general and tobacco plaintiffs to place this important new warning label on our cigarettes," said Bennett LeBow, chairman and chief executive of Brooke Group. "We believe warning smokers in clear, unambiguous language is the right thing to do."
